skills.belief: After common field prep, each cultivar zone must be planted with its planned seed and spacing.
skills.action_pattern: field prep, base fertilizer, ridging, plant each cultivar zone with planned seed and spacing, commit and recheck zones
constraints: do not mix cultivar seed plans

skills.belief: Treat wet-zone HN84 disease only after disease evidence is confirmed by weather/soil/canopy, drone, zone state, reference, and ground checks.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck spray window, apply targeted fungicide to confirmed HN84 disease zone, recheck disease pressure
constraints: do not use fungicide for water, weed, insect, or nutrient stress

skills.belief: Irrigate HN58 dry-zone stress only when soil moisture and canopy/thermal evidence support water stress.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck irrigation window and budget, irrigate confirmed dry zone, recheck response
constraints: do not irrigate disease, weed, insect, or nutrient stress

skills.belief: Cultivar zones can differ in maturity and grain moisture; choose harvest order from zone evidence.
skills.action_pattern: harvest ready zones in 4-ridge blocks, unload, dry if needed, store, recheck inventory
constraints: do not store wet grain directly
